entities.summary: Ryan George Lindley is an American football coach and former quarterback who is currently the senior offensive analyst at San Diego State University. He played college football for the San Diego State Aztecs, and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the sixth round of the 2012 NFL draft. Lindley also played for the Indianapolis Colts of the NFL, and the Ottawa Redblacks of the Canadian Football League (CFL).
